title: Owens' three-UFO-sighting experiment around San Francisco
place_text: within 100 miles of San Francisco (San Diego as control)

tellings.quote: I'm going to create three UFO sightings within a 90-day period within a 100 miles of San Francisco.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a doctorate who studies psychic claims, says that in 1976 a man named Ted Owens announced he would create three UFO sightings within 90 days and within 100 miles of San Francisco, with San Diego used as a comparison area. Mishlove tells it as a test he was involved in, which, if it worked, would suggest a person could summon UFOs at will.
